description: Camera movement presets for xianxia video generation (AnimateDiff V4 StoryEngine)

presets.prompt_suffix: continuous forward-moving aerial shot gliding through layers of misty clouds, camera pushing through volumetric fog revealing mountain peaks and ancient temples beyond, smooth parallax motion with depth, atmospheric perspective shifting as clouds part
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, locked off shot, ground level, no camera movement, talking head, selfie angle

presets.prompt_suffix: top-down bird's eye view camera slowly descending toward the ground, altitude gradually decreasing to reveal terrain details, smooth vertical dolly downward, world expanding in frame as camera drops closer
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, ground level perspective, upward angle, no vertical movement, handheld shake

presets.prompt_suffix: camera crane rising upward from ground level to reveal a vast landscape beyond, smooth continuous vertical ascent, foreground subject shrinking as the epic scale of the world is unveiled above, dramatic perspective shift from intimate to grand
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, descending motion, ground locked, no vertical movement, tight framing throughout

presets.prompt_suffix: sweeping aerial dolly shot soaring above jagged mountain ridges, camera banking and gliding like a bird in flight, parallax between foreground peaks and distant valleys, golden light catching on cliff faces as the camera sweeps laterally across the landscape
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, ground level, interior shot, no lateral movement, locked off framing

presets.prompt_suffix: intense handheld tracking camera following fast martial arts combat, slight camera shake matching the energy of sword strikes, quick reframing to follow the action, dynamic angles shifting between combatants, kinetic and urgent camera movement
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, tripod locked, smooth glide, slow movement, wide establishing shot, no camera shake

presets.prompt_suffix: fast-moving tracking shot pursuing a figure through the environment, camera racing forward with urgency, obstacles passing on both sides creating depth and speed, motion blur on peripheral elements, continuous forward momentum with slight lateral adjustments
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, stationary framing, slow pace, no forward movement, locked off wide shot

presets.prompt_suffix: extremely fast horizontal whip pan transition, camera snapping rapidly from one subject to another with heavy motion blur in the middle of the movement, abrupt and energetic lateral sweep connecting two moments
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: slow pan, static camera, smooth gentle movement, no motion blur, locked off shot

presets.prompt_suffix: camera movement with dramatic speed ramping, starting in slow motion then rapidly accelerating to high speed, time dilation effect transitioning from detailed slow-mo to explosive fast motion, dramatic tempo shift in a single continuous shot
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: constant speed, static camera, uniform pacing, no speed variation, locked off shot

presets.prompt_suffix: camera orbiting smoothly around the subject in a full 360-degree arc, continuous circular dolly movement maintaining constant distance, background rotating behind the subject creating a dramatic revolving perspective, steady and controlled orbital motion
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, no rotation, linear dolly, locked off framing, flat angle

presets.prompt_suffix: dolly zoom vertigo effect, camera physically moving backward while simultaneously zooming in on the subject, background warping and stretching unnaturally while the subject remains the same size, creating a disorienting spatial compression, Hitchcock zoom effect
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, normal perspective, no distortion, standard zoom, flat composition

presets.prompt_suffix: very slow and deliberate camera push forward toward the subject, gradually tightening the frame, creeping dolly in building tension and focus, nearly imperceptible continuous forward motion drawing the viewer deeper into the scene
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: fast movement, pulling back, static camera, abrupt motion, handheld shake

presets.prompt_suffix: camera slowly pulling backward to reveal the larger scene around the subject, dolly out widening the frame from a close detail to expose the full environment, gradual unveiling of context and scale, dramatic expansion of visible space
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: pushing in, static camera, tight framing throughout, no reveal, zoom in

presets.prompt_suffix: extreme close-up on a face with shallow depth of field, smooth rack focus shifting from the eyes to a background element and back, bokeh background transitioning between sharp and soft, intimate and emotionally revealing camera work with minimal movement
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: wide shot, deep focus, fast movement, full body framing, no depth of field change

presets.prompt_suffix: over-the-shoulder shot framed past a foreground figure looking at the subject beyond, shallow depth of field with the shoulder and head softly out of focus in the near foreground, subtle camera breathing movement, conversational and grounded perspective
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: frontal shot, no foreground element, wide establishing, aerial view, fast camera movement

presets.prompt_suffix: side profile shot of the subject rendered as a dramatic silhouette against a bright background, camera holding steady with very subtle lateral drift, strong rim light outlining the figure, contrasty backlit composition with minimal fill
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: frontal view, flat lighting, no silhouette, overlit face, fast camera movement

presets.prompt_suffix: ultra-wide establishing shot capturing the full scope of the environment, camera holding mostly steady with a very slow lateral pan, deep focus from foreground to distant background, grand scale composition emphasizing the setting over any single subject
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: close-up, tight framing, shallow DOF, fast movement, subject filling frame

presets.prompt_suffix: time-lapse style shot with accelerated cloud movement and shifting light while the camera executes a slow continuous horizontal pan across the landscape, day transitioning through lighting changes, compressed time with smooth lateral camera sweep
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: real-time speed, static camera, no time compression, tight framing, night only

presets.prompt_suffix: lateral tracking shot with strong parallax depth, foreground elements like trees and rocks sliding past quickly while distant mountains and sky move slowly, multi-layered depth creating a three-dimensional sense of space, smooth steady horizontal dolly
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, flat composition, no depth layers, aerial shot, close-up framing

presets.prompt_suffix: camera slowly rising as if levitating with the meditating subject, gentle upward float matching the character ascending from the ground, spiritual energy particles drifting downward relative to the rising camera, serene and weightless vertical ascent, world falling away below
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, grounded perspective, fast movement, descending shot, handheld shake

presets.prompt_suffix: camera circling slowly around a cultivator gathering spiritual energy, orbital dolly with a gradual spiral tightening inward, luminous qi particles swirling in the same rotational direction as the camera, building intensity as the orbit accelerates slightly, vortex-like camera movement converging on the subject
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, no rotation, linear movement, no energy effects, flat lighting

presets.prompt_suffix: dramatic rapid camera pull-back from a tight close-up as a massive energy explosion erupts outward from the subject, shockwave expanding toward the camera, extreme dolly out matching the blast radius, debris and energy particles flying past the lens, sudden violent expansion of the frame from intimate to epic scale
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, slow movement, pushing in, calm scene, no energy effects, gentle pacing

presets.prompt_suffix: continuous first-person flying shot as if riding on a sword through the sky, camera racing forward above the clouds with wind-swept motion, banking left and right around mountain peaks, dipping below cloud layers and bursting back above, exhilarating high-speed aerial point-of-view with parallax depth
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, ground level, third person view, slow movement, interior shot, locked off framing

presets.prompt_suffix: rapid camera snap-zoom into a bright flash of light followed by an instant cut to a completely new environment, abrupt spatial discontinuity simulating teleportation, brief white-out or energy burst bridging two locations, disorienting but deliberate jump in camera position
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: slow transition, smooth dolly, continuous movement, no flash effect, gradual dissolve

presets.prompt_suffix: tilted dutch angle shot creating visual unease and tension, camera canted at a diagonal with a slow creeping push forward, off-kilter horizon line amplifying psychological discomfort, slight rotational drift adding to the destabilized feeling
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: level horizon, static camera, stable framing, no tilt, calm composition

presets.prompt_suffix: low angle camera looking upward at the subject from below, emphasizing power and dominance, slight upward tilt with a slow push forward, towering figure framed against the sky, heroic and imposing perspective with the subject looming large in the frame
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: high angle, looking down, bird's eye view, level angle, diminishing subject

presets.prompt_suffix: camera plunging downward in a rapid free-fall, rushing toward the ground with increasing speed, environment streaking upward past the lens, vertigo-inducing straight-down descent with wind and debris rushing past, terminal velocity camera drop
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: static camera, ascending shot, slow movement, horizontal tracking, stable framing

presets.prompt_suffix: top-down overhead shot looking straight down at a glowing magical formation array on the ground, camera slowly rotating clockwise as the formation activates, concentric circles and runes illuminating in sequence below, measured rotational spin matching the ritual energy, geometric patterns expanding outward
presets.negative_prompt_suffix: side angle, ground level, no rotation, close-up on face, fast movement, no magical effects
